title.value: Can Open Source Licenses Help Regulate Lethal Autonomous Weapons?
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Can Open Source Licenses Help Regulate Lethal Autonomous Weapons?

analysis.description: The paper explores the potential of using open source licenses as a regulatory mechanism for lethal autonomous weapons (LAWS) due to the challenges associated with traditional regulation methods for software-based technologies. It analyzes the feasibility and limitations of ethics-driven licenses in preventing the development and use of LAWS.

type.justification: The paper primarily discusses theoretical concepts and the potential implications of using open source licensing as a means of regulation, rather than conducting experiments or collecting empirical data.
type.quote: Our recent work [5], we sought to explore this suggestion by addressing the following question: Can open source licenses help regulate the development of lethal autonomous weapons?

name.justification: The paper discusses the ethical implications and regulatory challenges of using AI in lethal autonomous weapons, aligning closely with the field of ethics in AI.
name.quote: As an experimental roboticist, she specializes in ethics and responsible design of interactive robots and AI systems.
